subject: attn
title: ATTN.------AFI.
description: Chart 1 of 3 on book p. 231 (T(IMP)M-29). ATTN (attraction) is the subject; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: COS-P (cosmic particulars), INDIV-DY-TD (individual tendencies) and VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From COS-P: SF-RZ (self-realization) and PER-VT-U-FUND (perceived vibrational universe fundamental). From SF-RZ: SPT-GH (spiritual growth). From INDIV-DY-TD: ACT (activism). From ACT: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From VT-DY: UTZ (utilization). From UTZ: HI-P (high purpose). From HI-P: WO-UNF (world unification).
